notes: The purpose `לְ` takes the complementizer *That* while the infinitive keeps its supplied subject pronoun and modal (rule 52).
Both marginal notes (*Or, That they may keep*; *Or, Yea, he preserveth*) were read and set aside (rule 38); the variant unit selected the base reading covering s007–s008 (rule 9).
The `חֲסִידָיו` unit is discontinuous around the possessive, which is the suffix's own word (rules 19, 25 and 18).
